title: Hold'em Pub
description:
Basement level, near Gangnam Station.

Down the stairs — six green felt tables.

Seat fee: ₩8,000 per hour. The bets each player raises aren't 'gambling' by legal logic.

{name}'s first time. Knew the rules. Learned them on YouTube.

choices.text: Take a seat at the low-stakes table
choices.result_text:
2 hours, ₩20,000 in losses.
But two successful bluffs, and once pulled a big pot before giving it back.

Walking up the stairs, a thought formed. There's something to study in this game.

Stood and watched for an hour.
The good players didn't look at their cards. They looked at people.
What that difference means — still unknown.

title: Read People, Not Cards
description:
The man across the table made a big raise.

Strong hand or bluff?

His fingers tapped the table. No sweat on his forehead.
Voice steady. But his eyes briefly looked down.

{name} had to decide.

choices.result_text:
Correct.
The table went quiet when the opponent flipped his cards.

{name} pulled in the chips without a word.
Keeping a straight face is part of the game.

Folded. The opponent showed his cards. It was a bluff.

No regret. Putting money in without certainty is worse.
Learning that — that was the tuition.

title: Bad Beat
description:
Pocket aces.

The odds of losing with this hand are under 20%. Flop, turn — still ahead.

On the river, the opponent hit trips.

A statistically absurd thing just happened right in front of {name}.

choices.result_text:
Slid the chips over.
"Bad beat," the dealer said.
{name} nodded.

Did nothing wrong. That's why the loss was clean.
Playing poker well and making money at poker are different things.

choices.text: On tilt — go all-in recklessly next hand
choices.result_text:
Made the decision with emotion. The result was predetermined.

Lost ₩150,000 and left.
Gangnam street outside. Cold and bright.

Principles always collapse this fast.

title: Became a Regular
description:
Third visit — the dealer recognized the face.

"Back again today."

A discount coupon for the seat fee. Regular treatment.

A thought flashed: is this a good thing?

choices.text: Take the perks and keep coming
choices.result_text:
30% off seat fee. ₩6,000.
The faces at the table started becoming familiar.

Here, job and age don't exist. In front of the cards, everyone's equal.
That was strangely comfortable.

choices.text: Becoming a 'regular' doesn't feel like a good sign — step back
choices.result_text:
"I'll skip today."
Walked up the stairs.

Gangnam night. People passing by.

Nothing particularly accomplished, but felt okay.
Not doing something is a choice too.

title: Big Pot
description:
The biggest pot of the session was building.

The opponent was calm. Large chip stack.
{name}'s hand wasn't bad. That was the problem — not bad.

Calling means betting everything won today.

choices.result_text:
Won.

Gasps from the table. The opponent flipped cards and stood up.

{name} felt hands slightly trembling while stacking chips.
Worried about wanting to feel this again.

Put the chips down.

Opponent showed the cards. Would have lost.

Strangely satisfied. Not losing what you would have lost — that's winning too.
